limits: Neither EBIT bridge is sustainable earnings: recurring booking estimates and CAS customer recovery remain economically relevant.
No double addition of 1615 prior program loss to both profit and cash; unpaid reserves still consume future cash.
Pension liability and amortization/recoveries need integrated treatment; all cash-after-SBC figures are proxies, not owner FCF.
Debt gross rollforward is illustrative, not independently reconciled September principal; current carrying debt is not nominal redemption value.
ULA guarantee ceiling is not an immediate certain payment and its equity carrying amount is not realizable surplus cash.
